record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: If X has negative sectional curvature and μ_i are the probability measures |φ_i(x)|^2 dV(x) associated with Laplace eigenfunctions, does μ_i converge to dV as i→∞?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 49 (Quantum unique ergodicity). Suppose that X has negative sec-tional curvature. Then µi → dV as i → ∞ .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Riemannian manifold of negative sectional curvature, with Riemannian volume measure $dV$ normalized to be a probability measure. Let $\{\varphi_i\}_{i\ge 1}$ be an orthonormal basis of $L^2(X, dV)$ consisting of eigenfunctions of the Laplace–Beltrami operator on $X$, with eigenvalues $\lambda_i \to \infty$. For each $i$, define the probability measure
$$\mu_i := |\varphi_i(x)|^2\, dV(x)$$
on $X$. Prove or disprove: $\mu_i \to dV$ weakly as $i \to \infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The Quantum Unique Ergodicity conjecture of Rudnick–Sarnak remains open in general for compact negatively curved manifolds. In the arithmetic setting (compact arithmetic hyperbolic surfaces from quaternion algebras, and the modular surface), the conjecture for Hecke eigenfunctions was established by Lindenstrauss (2006) and Soundararajan (for the modular surface, completing the non-compact case). Significant entropy-based partial results in the general case are due to Anantharaman and collaborators, but the full conjecture for arbitrary negatively curved manifolds is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Invariant measures and arithmetic quantum unique ergodicity
status_evidence.snippet: Lindenstrauss established arithmetic QUE for Hecke eigenfunctions on compact arithmetic hyperbolic surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Arithmetic QUE proved in the Hecke eigenfunction setting.

status_evidence.title: Background on the Quantum Unique Ergodicity conjecture (AIM)
status_evidence.snippet: For manifolds with strictly negative curvature in general, the problem remains wide open, although Anantharaman made important partial progress.
status_evidence.claim: General QUE for negatively curved manifolds is still open.

status_evidence.title: Recent progress on the quantum unique ergodicity conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Survey describes resolution in arithmetic cases and partial progress elsewhere.
status_evidence.claim: Partial resolution in arithmetic settings; general case open.
